title.narrative: Biomass Energy for productive use for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in the olive oil sector (CEO)

description.narrative: The Endorsement letter signed by GEF Operational Focal Point, dated 17 November 2011 - The project aims to increase the use of biomass in industrial energy consumption for productive use through demonstrated use of modern biomass technologies in Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (SMEs) in the olive oil industry.
